title: Reading frequencies
objective: Read radio frequencies digit by digit with "decimal".

phraseologyNote.title: Frequencies
phraseologyNote.shortExplanation: Say all six figures and "decimal" for the point. Only when the last two are zeros are the first four enough: 122.500 is "one two two decimal fife".
overview: Frequencies are said digit by digit, with "decimal" for the point. ICAO digits apply: tree, fife, niner.
With 8.33 kHz channel spacing the full six figures identify the channel. Only when the last two figures are zeros may the first four be enough.
phraseologyNote.whyItMatters: A wrong frequency means losing contact with ATC.
